name: UnitStackRecord
description: Per-army stack record inside gameData holding tile coordinates, ownership, slots, and the cached move path.

fields.name: tile_row
fields.notes: Row on the 200-column world grid used to stamp tile occupancy and fog-of-war.

fields.name: tile_column
fields.notes: Column on the world grid; combined with row to index TILE_INDEX.

fields.name: owner_player_index
fields.notes: Player id copied from PLAYER_DATA and reused by fog-of-war (dword_5202EC).

fields.name: facing_direction
fields.notes: 0-7 direction used by sprite/orientation logic during path highlighting.

fields.name: unit_slots[10]
fields.notes: Each slot stores type id, owner, morale (offset +9), veterancy seed (offset +11), and state bits (offset +13).

fields.name: path_buffer
fields.notes: Movement track copied in/out by qmemcpy during path planning.

unit_slot_fields.name: unit_type_id
unit_slot_fields.notes: -1 marks an empty slot; values index the 88-byte unit stat tables.

unit_slot_fields.name: slot_owner
unit_slot_fields.notes: Owner copied from stack reset; used for loyalty/morale adjustments.

unit_slot_fields.name: base_action_points
unit_slot_fields.notes: Seeded from byte_512580 when the slot is initialized.

unit_slot_fields.name: morale_percent
unit_slot_fields.notes: Starts at 100 and drives combat multipliers.

unit_slot_fields.name: speed_penalty
unit_slot_fields.notes: Cleared on init; reused by status effects.

unit_slot_fields.name: veterancy_seed
unit_slot_fields.notes: Set to 6 for light units and 10 otherwise using dword_51257A flags.

unit_slot_fields.name: slot_flags
unit_slot_fields.notes: Bit0 stores the per-turn readiness flag toggled by UnitStack_ClearReadyFlags/SetReadyFlags.

unit_slot_fields.name: status_dword
unit_slot_fields.notes: Zeroed on init; reused by casualties/movement cost accumulation.

unit_slot_fields.name: state_bits
unit_slot_fields.notes: Low bit cleared on init; pairs with slot_flags for move gating.

evidence: Unit_Create uses 147174 + 725 * index to address stacks, writing row/column/facing before stamping TILE_INDEX.
UnitSlot_InitFromType writes the slot fields (type id, owner, base stats) at offsets relative to stackPtr + 6.
UnitStack_UpdateVision and UnitStack_HasReadyUnits read these slots and field offsets to drive fog-of-war and readiness states.
